# The Vulkan GS renderer from ps2-port-engine, built without its window and host.
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(vulkan_headers GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers.git GIT_TAG v1.4.363 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_Declare(volk GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/zeux/volk.git GIT_TAG vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
set(VOLK_PULL_IN_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(vulkan_headers)
set(VOLK_HEADERS_ONLY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(VULKAN_HEADERS_INSTALL_DIR "${vulkan_headers_SOURCE_DIR}" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(volk)

find_program(RC_GLSLANG glslangValidator REQUIRED)
set(SHADERS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/gpu/shaders)
set(OUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shaders)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${OUT})
set(HEADERS)
function(rc_shader name source)
    set(out ${OUT}/${name}.h)
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${out}
        COMMAND ${RC_GLSLANG} -V --target-env vulkan1.1 ${ARGN} --vn spirv_${name} -I${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/gpu/third_party/smaa -o ${out} ${SHADERS}/${source}
        DEPENDS ${SHADERS}/${source} ${SHADERS}/gs_address.glsl ${SHADERS}/smaa_common.glsl)
    set(HEADERS ${HEADERS} ${out} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
foreach(shader gs.vert gs.frag date.vert date.frag swizzle.comp decode.comp depth_load.frag patch.comp shuffle.comp fxaa.comp downsample.comp smaa_edges.comp smaa_weights.comp smaa_blend.comp)
    string(REPLACE "." "_" name ${shader})
    rc_shader(${name} ${shader})
endforeach()
rc_shader(gs_frag_single gs.frag -DSINGLE_OUTPUT)
rc_shader(swizzle_image_comp swizzle.comp -DIMAGE)
rc_shader(decode_image_comp decode.comp -DTO_IMAGE)
rc_shader(swizzle_depth_comp swizzle.comp -DDEPTH_IMAGE)
rc_shader(gs_frag_blend gs.frag -DSHADER_BLEND)
foreach(pass RANGE 0 15)
    rc_shader(effects_${pass} effects.comp -DPASS=${pass})
endforeach()
add_custom_target(rc_vk_shaders DEPENDS ${HEADERS})

add_library(rc_port_engine STATIC
    gpu/src/gpu.cpp gpu/src/vk_device.cpp gpu/src/gs_renderer.cpp gpu/src/effects.cpp gpu/src/threaded_renderer.cpp
    host/src/gs.cpp host/src/gs_draw.cpp host/src/gs_memory.cpp host/src/gs_blend.cpp host/src/gpu_bridge.cpp rc_stubs.cpp)
add_dependencies(rc_port_engine rc_vk_shaders)
target_include_directories(rc_port_engine PUBLIC gpu/include host/include PRIVATE ${OUT} gpu/third_party/smaa)
target_compile_definitions(rc_port_engine PUBLIC PS2HOST_VULKAN=1)
target_compile_options(rc_port_engine PRIVATE -O2 -w -mno-fma)
set_target_properties(rc_port_engine PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17 CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
target_link_libraries(rc_port_engine PRIVATE volk::volk Vulkan::Headers)
